newsitem.title: UK: Hawtal gains on emission control hopes.
newsitem.headline: Hawtal gains on emission control hopes.

text.p: Shares in Hawtal Whiting Holdings Plc rose on Friday as a newspaper report highlighted prospects for the engineering services group's auto emissions control devices.
The stock was up 7-1/2p at 142-1/2 by 1148 GMT in slim volume of just 5,500 shares.

Noting a sharp rise in the stock since late June, the Daily Telegraph said there was talk that the devices were about to receive a positive report from the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), one of the independent groups which has been testing them.
Finance director Chris Russell told Reuters a report was due in the next few weeks but declined further comment.

He pointed to a statement issued by the company on June 24, when Hawtal said its devices were completing test programmes at independent laboratories and that initial results, including those from the EPA, were "encouraging."
